reasoning_content: Now let me check nginx config to set up proxy for port 3000.

action.command:
cd /workspace/project && python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko

client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")

# Check nginx config
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("ls /etc/nginx/sites-* 2>&1")
print("nginx:", stdout.read().decode())

# Check what's running on port 3000
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("ss -tlnp | grep 3000")
print("port:", stdout.read().decode())

client.close()
EOF
